<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex02032025-04-2514-39-502" status="finalized"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:5552"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha cig</rs></rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5552">braM ze</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsa ba</rs>s don 'jug pa'i yang lag yin yang</note> ni bstan chos kyi gzhung gi tshig gam yi ge mdzes pa skyed pa'i ched du tsam yin zer ba 
         <note type="gloss">de skad du yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">ma ha</rs> na re khyed bstan chos rtsom ma (myong) rnaMs la sdud <abbr>med</abbr> de ngad bstan chos rtsom myang pa rnaMs la sdus yod pa yin de dgos 'brel <abbr>med</abbr> pa'i bstan chos mi mdzes par 'dug gsung skad |</note> 
         yod mod kyi | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">slob dpon</rs> 'dis ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3780">slob dpon <lb edRef="inst:4454" n="47a4"/> chos mchog</rs> gi rjes su 'brangs nas | dgos 'brel gyi tshig la brten nas rnam gcad la don du mi 'gyur ba'i the tsom bzhi po ldog pa'i yan lag du 'gyur pa bsal nas | <note type="gloss">rnaM bcad la dgos pa de bsal pa'i sgo nas</note>yongs gcod la don du 'gyur ba'i the tsom bzhi po 'jug pa'i yan lag du 'gyur ba bskyed nas <note type="editorial">Eye-skip (?) in (ID:6286), "ldog pa'i yan lag...bskyed" missing</note> nyan pa po bstan chos la 'jug pa'i <note type="gloss">de rgyu</note> yan lag du yin no zhes 'dod do ||</seg></TEI>
